The disagreement resolved toward the hot model - the add became CONFIRMED exactly at near-window entry. This is the exact mirror of 0629 (wind +62% / +660,219 MWh, burn -4.2 Bcf/d, the up-forecast day printed -1,160): same instrument, opposite gate state, opposite outcome. Phase conviction: ph1 +296/+110 ALIGNED up; ph2 +84/+270 aligned-but-flowless; ph3 -69/+410 = price +410 on noise-level negative flow. This is PASSIVE MARKUP - the offer ladder repricing upward on the fundamental confirmation without aggressive buying - the signature of a forecast-led day, not a flow-led day. It also explains why every blind flow channel missed: the D-1 tape genuinely was a near-neutral coil (phase_b_two_sided 0.487/0.483/0.489), and a coil is direction-agnostic - its RESOLUTION was set by the weather slope, which in a summer block outranks the flows/storage family per the seasonal-salience slider (doctrine: weather carries maximum weight in summer; realized gw_cdd ran 9.0 -> 18.7 across g22). proposal_contribution: PROPOSAL 1 - WEATHER SLOPE PRICES AT NEAR-WINDOW ENTRY, AND ROLL-DOWN IS NOT A REVISION (CDD extension of the s101_6 pricing-time rule; implements the S109 asymmetric-slope doctrine): in the seasonal-salience summer/winter regime, a rising CDD/HDD track is a CONTINUOUS driver that prices segment by segment as each segment (a) ENTERS the near window D0..D+2 by roll-down and (b) is CONFIRMED (cross-model spread narrowing / the skeptic model raising). 'The forecast did not change' (run_delta ~ 0) does NOT mean 'priced' - the revision-arm inertness of signal.mos_first_appearance_vs_revision is scoped to wobbles at horizons of an already-PRICED shot and must never be applied to roll-down of a rising track. A hill slopes: the market walks up it day by day; it does not gap the whole hill at appearance. On such an entry day the D-1 tape tilt loses sign authority (a coil resolves to the slope side; even a coherent counter-tape only damps magnitude). Evidence n>=3 spanning groups: g13 0220 +590 (moderate add pricing at near-window entry) and 0222 +1310 (peak at D0/D+1 + delivery pull); g22 0624 +800 (entry day: step 7.817->10.022 at D0, spread 1.632->0.907, blind -200 wrong-signed); counter-instance defining the required gate limb: g22 0629 (entry arrived as forecast, day printed -1,160 because the transmission was closed - see Proposal 2). Magnitude stays DERIVED: floor = the measured moderate-entry class (~+590 winter); the S109 asymmetry damps the heat side ('up, but only some'); delivery pull and pre-binary calendar shift placement within band. PROPOSAL 2 - THE BURN-TRANSMISSION GATE (renewable subtractor as a limb of Proposal 1, n=2 IN-GROUP ONLY, needs a cross-group instance before merge): a confirmed CDD entry prices UP only when grid_stack shows the burn channel OPEN - est_gas_burn_bcfd rising d/d (equivalently: demand rising AND wind not surging). g22 0624: wind -22%, demand +8.3%, burn +6.3 Bcf/d -> +800. g22 0629: wind +62% (+660,219 MWh), burn -4.2 Bcf/d against the arriving heat -> -1,160. Same instrument, opposite gate state, opposite outcome; both values were served and unread. Proposed as a GATE LIMB (sign-authority condition) of the slope play, not a standalone play, and explicitly flagged n=2-within-one-group against the n>=2-spanning-groups bar - it rides G23+ for its cross-group instance. DATA BUILD FLAGGED WITH BOTH: serve the full CDD forecast ladder (horizons, run_delta, fwd7 span) exactly as the HDD one is served - Proposal 1 cannot see past D+1 in a CDD regime until then.
